About this collection and design

methodology

the collection began with johnny’s saved bookmarks. page titles were matched to source links, grouped by topic, and reviewed to create original reading commentary: what each topic offers, why it might matter, where to begin, and a small way to try it.

the approach combines curation, synthesis, plain language, and progressive disclosure. source links remain available for deeper reading. video courses were not watched and tutorial code was not run; the reading order is a suggestion.
